name: Lesser Nagua

variantInfo.name: Sulphur Nagua
notes: Uses a special attack every 5 auto-attacks that drains 5 prayer points if not avoided by moving out of melee range.
Supplies can be made freely in Neypotzli; moonlight potions act as super combat, divine super defence, and prayer restoration.

variantInfo.name: Frost Nagua
notes: Periodically marks the player's current tile, draining prayer if the player does not move away before the effect triggers.

variantInfo.name: Earthen Nagua
notes: Only appears after completion of The Final Dawn.
At 60% or lower hitpoints it shuffles its melee defence bonuses, becoming much weaker to crush attacks while gaining resistance to stab and slash.

variantInfo.name: Amoxliatl
notes: Boss variant of Frost Nagua at the Ruins of Tapoyauik; players assigned Lesser Nagua there may kill Amoxliatl as an alternative for better profit.
Brimstone keys are only dropped if killed on a Slayer task given by Konar quo Maten.

locationComparison.name: Neypotzli
notes: Supplies can be made freely here, preventing the need to bring your own supplies.

locationComparison.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
notes: 11 Frost Nagua, plus the Amoxliatl boss alternative.
Supplies cannot be made here, but moonlight moths can be caught inside to restore prayer.

locationComparison.name: Crypt of Tonali
notes: Earthen Nagua in the eastern sun chamber; the wiki does not state a spawn count.
Requires completion of The Final Dawn; moonlight moths can be caught nearby.

locationComparison.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik - Amoxliatl chamber
notes: Repeatable boss after The Heart of Darkness. Counts for Lesser Nagua assignments at the Ruins of Tapoyauik.

taskNotes: Lesser Nagua require 48 Slayer, 70 combat, and completion of Perilous Moons; they are assigned by Chaeldar (50-100, weight 4) and Konar (55-120, weight 2).
No task-extension unlock exists for Lesser Nagua.
All variants have negative flat armour (-4 or -2), so weapons that make multiple hitsplats, such as the Dual Macuahuitl, are generally more effective.
Nagua have very high ranged and magic defence bonuses but a low defence level against melee.
Sulphur Nagua drain 5 prayer points every 5 auto-attacks unless the player steps out of melee range.
Frost Nagua mark the player's tile and drain prayer if the player does not move away in time.
Earthen Nagua below 60% hitpoints become much weaker to crush while resisting stab and slash, and require The Final Dawn.
Moonlight moths (Hunter) can be caught in the Ruins of Tapoyauik and near the Crypt of Tonali to restore prayer; supplies can be made freely in Neypotzli.
Players assigned Lesser Nagua at the Ruins of Tapoyauik may kill the Amoxliatl boss as a more profitable alternative.

slayerTargetId 246 is a synthetic placeholder per the WC-1..11 contract (240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Lesser Nagua is unverified and detection falls back to the RuneLite task-name path.
recommendedMethod: Kill Sulphur Nagua in Neypotzli with a multi-hitsplat melee weapon such as the Dual Macuahuitl, making moonlight potions and supplies inside; step out of melee range to dodge the prayer-drain special. On Konar Tapoyauik locks, fight Frost Nagua (fire spells exploit their 50% weakness) or take Amoxliatl for profit.
